prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is close, grab it; if not, approach it. Move and perform task if conditions are met. list of available nodes: <Action ID = FindAndGrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDesignatedSite    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectPropertyXTrue    /> <Action ID = PerformSpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
		DO FindAndGrabObject
		DO MoveToDesignatedSite
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectPropertyXTrue? THEN
				DO PerformSpecificTask
		END
	END
